description: This file contains unit tests for the tenantClient utility functions, including testing normalization, fetching, selecting, and setting tenants.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes various forms of tenant identifiers into a string or null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches tenants associated with the current session from the API.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Selects a tenant by ID, updates local storage, and posts selection to the API.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Sets the active tenant in local storage, removing legacy entries.
